build.binaryNote: The fork source moved from an untracked local clone at .vendor/codex-fork to a squashed Git subtree tracked in-repo at vendor/codex, same pinned commit and patch. This hash is from the build at the repo root (C:\Users\karol\Documents\ChatGPT\Multi-ID\vendor\codex), where the worker actually resolves the binary from. Rust debug builds embed the absolute source path, so an identical source tree built under a different checkout path (e.g. a throwaway git-worktree import location) produces a different binary hash; lockfileSha256 above is unchanged and reproduced byte-for-byte from both locations, which is the actual provenance proof.
